data.description:
AIGroup 市场 MCP 服务器是一个全面的金融数据平台，提供丰富的市场洞察和分析。主要功能包括：

时间与新闻获取：通过智能搜索获取当前时间戳和实时新闻，来源于主要金融媒体
市场数据：获取全球市场的历史和分钟级股票、指数、加密货币数据，包括A股、美国股市、港股、外汇、期货等
宏观经济数据：访问利率、GDP、CPI、PPI、货币供应量、PMI和社会融资等宏观经济指标，支持多种格式
企业财务信息：检索上市公司详细财报、业绩指标和企业信息，覆盖中国大陆、香港和美国市场
基金数据：获取公开基金的全面信息，包括基金列表、经理资料、净值、分红、持仓等
专业市场洞察：访问大宗交易数据、资金流向、融资融券信息、龙虎榜机构交易、行业指数、成分股和估值指标
新闻与热点话题：全天候更新财经、政治、科技、体育、娱乐、军事、社会和国际新闻
基础信息：获取股票、交易日历、新股、指数、ETF等基础市场数据
data.description_en:
AIGroup Market MCP Server is a comprehensive financial data platform that provides rich market insights and analysis. Its main features include:

Time and News Access: Obtain current timestamps and real-time news through intelligent search, sourced from major financial media.
Market Data: Access historical and minute-level data for global markets, including stocks, indices, and cryptocurrencies, covering A-shares, U.S. stock markets, Hong Kong stock markets, foreign exchange, futures, and more.
Macroeconomic Data: Access macroeconomic indicators such as interest rates, GDP, CPI, PPI, money supply, PMI, and social financing, supporting multiple formats.
Corporate Financial Information: Retrieve detailed financial reports, performance metrics, and corporate information of listed companies, covering markets in the Chinese Mainland, Hong Kong, and the United States.
Fund Data: Obtain comprehensive information on publicly available funds, including fund lists, manager details, net asset values, dividends, holdings, and more.
Professional Market Insights: Access data on block trades, capital flows, margin trading and securities lending information, institutional trading on the Dragon and Tiger List, industry indices, constituent stocks, and valuation metrics.
News and Hot Topics: Receive updates on financial, political, technology, sports, entertainment, military, social, and international news around the clock.
Basic Information: Access fundamental market data such as stocks, trading calendars, new listings, indices, and ETFs.
data.name: AIGroup 市场 MCP 服务器
